core.notes:
AWOO+ now includes Dungeon Win Rate and Sculpture Grid Labels: one script instead of three. Your separate copies switch themselves off and can be uninstalled
Modules shared with you personally now come as one script, AWOO+ Extras; AWOO+ offers to install it
Cost Tables now comes with AWOO+: open it from the Tools menu
AWOO+ sends a small daily diagnostics check-in (character name, village, install and browser info, versions and errors); never your inventory, currencies or login details
Profile Sync now uses captured live query names and the game's current React providers, and keeps page-specific data it already saw instead of losing it when you navigate away
